title: Your action reflects your love
lyrics:
Your Actions Reflect Your Love

Verse 1
Words can comfort for a little while,
But your actions carried me every mile.
When I was weak, you stood by my side,
You never left, you were my guide.

Pre-Chorus
You gave without asking for praise,
You lit my darkest days.
Your kindness spoke louder than words,
A love that truly could be heard.

Chorus
Your actions reflect your love, my brother,
A priceless gift like no other.
You lifted me when I couldn't stand,
With a faithful heart and helping hand.
Thank you for every sacrifice you've made,
For every prayer and every way you stayed.
Your actions reflect your love so true,
And I'll always be grateful to you.

Verse 2
You believed in me when I had no hope,
You taught me how to dream and cope.
Every step you took to help me rise,
Showed the love no words could describe.

Bridge
May God reward your faithful heart,
And bless your life in every part.
The love you've shown will never fade,
I'll remember every sacrifice you made.

Final Chorus
Your actions reflect your love, my brother,
Your kindness shines above all others.
Thank you for everything you've done for me,
Your love has helped me become who I am today.
Forever grateful, forever proud,
I'll speak your kindness strong and loud.
Your actions reflect your love so true,
My brother, this song is dedicated to you.
